notes: The image is a boot-mode jumper illustration of a RAK11200 mounted on a RAK5005-O base board. It shows the base board's headers (silkscreen J10, J11, J12) with only two pins called out (BOOT0 and GND, bridged by a jumper); all other header pins are unlabeled and none of the RAK11200 module's own pins are mapped. No usable connector map for this record.
